title: Fifteen years later, the Apple Cards origin story
why_read: A nostalgic retrospective on early Apple product design history, interesting mainly for those curious about Apple lore rather than current engineering practice.
analysis: This is a historical account of the origin of Apple's product cards or similar internal design artifacts from around 15 years ago. It offers insight into Apple's internal design culture and decision-making processes at the time. The technical relevance is limited since it is retrospective and design-history focused rather than something engineers can apply today.
